summary: I'll fix the fault that makes saving on your menu editor and your order queue come back "Bad Request", so adding items, changing prices and advancing orders all save again.

people.title: You sign in with a link emailed to you
people.detail: Unchanged. Only addresses you invite can get an account, and there are no staff logins.

people.title: Customers order as guests
people.detail: Unchanged. No account, no password, no order history.

canDo.title: Add a new item to your menu and have it save
canDo.detail: Name, description, price and category. It appears in your list straight away, and on the public menu once you mark it available.

canDo.title: Change an existing item's price or description and have it save
canDo.detail: The same fault broke editing as well as adding, so both are fixed together.

canDo.title: Hide or remove an item
canDo.detail: The same save path, so this is fixed by the same change.

canDo.title: Mark an order preparing, mark it ready, or cancel it
canDo.detail: You chose to have these fixed in this pass. They fail for exactly the same reason as the menu saves, so fixing them costs almost nothing extra.

canDo.title: I found the cause before planning this, rather than guessing again
canDo.detail: Each of these saves was sending the database its own "created" and "last changed" stamps. The database sets those two itself and rejects any save that tries to set them, with no message — which is the blank "Bad Request". Your shop settings screen kept working all along because it is the one save that never sends them. The fix is to stop sending them.

canDo.title: A check that stops this coming back
canDo.detail: Two earlier attempts changed these screens on a theory that turned out to be wrong, and the existing automatic checks could not tell. I'll add one that looks at what each save actually sends, so this exact mistake fails the build in future instead of reaching you.

screens.title: Your menu editor
screens.detail: Same screen, same buttons. Saving works.

screens.title: Your order queue
screens.detail: Same screen. "Mark preparing", "Mark ready" and "Cancel order" work.

screens.title: Nothing else moves
screens.detail: No new screens, no new buttons, nothing added to what the app stores, and no change to who can see what.

notInThisVersion.title: Older demo orders showing £0.00 on each line
notInThisVersion.detail: A display problem on the order queue, in the practice data only. You chose to leave it for now.

notInThisVersion.title: New orders still needing a page reload to appear
notInThisVersion.detail: On the order queue. You chose to leave it for now; I'd suggest it as the next thing.

notInThisVersion.title: The "Estimated ready" wording on the customer's confirmation page
notInThisVersion.detail: It shows a date with no time of day. Left exactly as it is.
